description: This file defines custom bitwise operation metamethods (__band, __bor, __bxor, __shl, __shr, __bnot) for strings, allowing bitwise operations on string operands by interpreting them as integers. It includes utility functions for converting values to integers and invoking metamethods when applicable.

methods.name: toint
methods.description: Converts a value to an integer if possible, using tonumber and math.tointeger.

methods.name: trymt
methods.description: Attempts to invoke a metamethod on a value if it exists.

methods.name: checkargs
methods.description: Checks and converts two arguments to integers or invokes metamethods if conversion fails.
